m-glyph-trace.svg.origin: potrace 1.16 outline of the 1292 x 1292 raster M embedded in the Figma export
m-glyph-trace.svg.command: magick m.png -alpha extract -threshold 50% -negate m.pbm && potrace m.pbm -s -u 10 -a 1.0 -O 0.2 -o m-glyph-trace.svg
m-glyph-trace.svg.fidelity: 0.05% of pixels differ between the traced outline and the raster mask at 1292 px
